push.title: W 3-1 vs Red 3 | You: 9.5
push.body:
A 9.5 against Red 3, buddskees. You made the hard things look ordinary, and that's a compliment.

THE GOOD
+ 33 passes (up from your usual 18). Every attack seemed to have your fingerprints on it.
+ Won 3 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 79%). Win the ball, start the attack. You did both.
+ A goal against Red 3, your 2nd straight match scoring. You treated that chance like a winning lottery ticket and cashed it.
+ 1 assist (down from your usual 2). Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ Man of the Match, your 9th for us. That's leadership you can't fake.

THE BAD
- No key passes from 33 passes. Next rep: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape. Trust the work.
- Misplaced passes 8, up from your usual 5. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). For next time: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.
- Tackles attempted: 3. 6+ is where top midfielders hang their hats.

Backyard drill: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.

Listen here, buddskees: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

What a joy. What a game. - Coach Lasso

+ 1 key pass. That pass had more vision than a lighthouse.
+ Feeding buddskees like that is a recipe I want to keep making.
+ Won your matchup: 8.3 against their best forward's 6.8. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ 4th straight match at 80% pass accuracy. That doesn't happen by accident.

THE BAD

- Shots: 2. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 3+.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

Every game teaches us something. - Coach Lasso

THE GOOD
+ Won 3 of 5 tackles (up from your usual 27%). You read their touch like a newspaper.
+ A goal against Red 3, your 2nd straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ 0.5 above usual. That's not luck, that's reps.
+ Their humans averaged 6.9 to our 8.7; we out-played them man for man. Put that in the team scrapbook.
+ Completed passes 15, from 11 in your previous match. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.

THE BAD
- 68% passing (15 of 22). Try this: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.2 (best was buddskees's 9.5). We can fix that.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 1). Honest truth: that cost us.
- Lowest goal involvements on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 2). That's the stone in your boot. Take it out.

Hey BellyTb1, hold onto this one: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso
